main_text.p: {a}Varrone , {b}Mela , rem probantibus , item Apud Soli-num.cap.16. {c}Callimacho , quanquam in Iovis gratiam indig-Lib.2. nante , patet. Osirin autem cujus exi­stimationis Hymn. in Iov. discrimine Plutarchus movetur , ut Callimachus Iovis, non solum {d}sepultura confensu historiarum Strab.lib. 17.Diodor. lib.i. part. i. (etsi de loco , ut {e}de Homeri patria , diffiden-Eudox.fa-cerd. Ægypt. &c. apud Plutarch. de Isid & Osir. e Cic.pro. Arch.poet.[?] tium ) testata , sed etiam color corporis , vel Plu-tarcho ipso agnoscente , suadet hominem exstitisse. Quo magis se ostendit animi affectu adversus veritatem rapi, qui videns teste temporum , luce veritatis , vetustatis nuntia (nam {f}historia merito ornatur his elogiis ) Osirin demonstrari corpus habuisse ; & {g}iciens daemones a Pythagora, Platone, similibusque philosophis animalcs naturas perhiberi, id est, animas, spiritus corporis expertes: tamen, ne Evemeri opinio invalescat, & elanguescant Ethnicae superstitiones, daemonibus, quales a Platone, Pythagora, & aliis, cum mali, tum boni statuuntur, Osirin accensendum ait. Num quia judicavit hoc & probabilius,& speciosius fore, quam quod {h}alibi dixit , & ob Romanorum Quirinum (utut faciat pro Evemeri dogmate) {i}putavit dici oportere, praestantiores animas ex hominibus in heroas, ex heroibus in daemonas, ex daemonibus autem, quum perpurgatae fuerint, in Deos mutari ? An illud in Osiride observandum ratus, quoddoctissimus {k}Varro significatum censet de Iside & Serapide : nimirum, omnibus fere in templis, ubi colebantur, idcirco exstitisse etiam {*}simulacrum, quod digito labiis impresso admonere videretur, ut silentium fieret, quo innueretur cavendum esse nequis diceret homines eos fuisse ? page.notes: Right margin notes (Greek, ψυχῆς entries): margin line "1 [illegible, ~10 letters] ψυχῆς" and "2 ψυχάς" with uncertain accents; Greek letters in the margin are small and partly unreadable. Margin "Diog. Laert. in Pythagora." and "h Lib. de defect.oraculor." and "1" entries are placed as printed beside lines 13 to 21. The note "e Cic.pro. Arch.poet." is doubtful. The mark "4*" after "diceret" in the text and the margin "4*" beside "gua Lat.lib.4." are uncertain. The word "Harpocratu:" may be an abbreviation of Harpocration and is doubtful. Long s is normalised to s throughout; "Ofir" in the scan is read as Osir.
